<style>*{box-sizing:border-box}*::before{box-sizing:border-box}*::after{box-sizing:border-box}.wz-js{display:none}</style><script class="wz-js" data-embed="">
/* CHAPTER 00 — ARRIVAL: the receipt stamp (SIGNATURE) + scrubbed departure. */
WZ.add(function (W) {
  var stamp = document.getElementById('stamp');
  var path = document.getElementById('stampPath');
  if (!stamp || !path) return;

  var length = path.getTotalLength();
  var tl = gsap.timeline({ defaults: { ease: 'power3.out' } });

  tl.from('#stampRing', { scale: 0.4, opacity: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: 'back.out(2)' })
    .fromTo(
      path,
      { strokeDasharray: length, strokeDashoffset: length },
      { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.inOut' },
      '-=0.15'
    )
    /* The ripple starts at the ring's own size and expands past it. It never
       settles on scale 1 — a transform landing exactly on 1 can flicker as
       the browser re-rasterises. */
    .fromTo(
      '#stampRipple',
      { scale: 1.02, opacity: 0.85 },
      { scale: 1.85, opacity: 0, duration: 1.1, ease: 'power2.out' },
      '-=0.35'
    );

  var title = document.getElementById('arrivalTitle');
  var split = W.splitLines(title);
  if (split && split.lines && split.lines.length) {
    gsap.set(split.lines, { yPercent: 115 });
    tl.to(split.lines, { yPercent: 0, duration: 1, stagger: 0.09, ease: 'power4.out' }, 0.45);
  }

  /* Departure — the whole confirmation recedes as you leave it. */
  gsap
    .timeline({ scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#arrival', start: 'top top', end: 'bottom top', scrub: 0.5 } })
    .to('#arrivalInner', { yPercent: -14, opacity: 0.25, ease: 'none' }, 0)
    .to('#stamp', { yPercent: -40, ease: 'none' }, 0)
    .to('#arrivalImg', { yPercent: 6, scale: 1.08, ease: 'none' }, 0)
    .to('#arrivalVeil', { opacity: 0.7, ease: 'none' }, 0);
});
</script>

/* PRACTICE TOKENS + LIVE OPEN/CLOSED STATUS (Asana 1217162605683014).
   Behaviour, not motion: runs at DOM-ready whatever GSAP says. A thank-you
   page is read minutes after the form is submitted, so "call us" is only
   useful if the visitor knows whether anyone is there to answer. Runs on the
   visitor's clock; the practice is US Central, which is accurate for local
   traffic — all a Richmond, TX campaign gets.

   SHARED ARCHETYPE — Mason Park Dental has the identical 4-section spec.
   To reuse: change PRACTICE below and the practice details in the markup. */
WZ.onReady(function () {
  var PRACTICE = {
    phoneDisplay: '(281) 789-8836',
    phoneDial: '+12817898836',
    /* Opening hours as published on grandmissiondentistry.com (2026-08-05).
       [openMinutes, closeMinutes] from midnight, or null when closed. The two
       vendor landing pages publish two *different* hour sets; this is the
       client's own current site, the one to trust until Brandklout confirms
       otherwise. Keep this table and the visible <dl> in step. */
    hours: {
      0: null,
      1: [9 * 60, 19 * 60],
      2: [10 * 60, 20 * 60],
      3: [10 * 60, 20 * 60],
      4: [8 * 60, 18 * 60],
      5: [8 * 60, 18 * 60],
      6: [8 * 60, 15 * 60],
    },
  };
  var DAY_NAMES = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'];

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tel]').forEach(function (el) {
    el.textContent = PRACTICE.phoneDisplay;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tel-link]').forEach(function (el) {
    el.setAttribute('href', 'tel:' + PRACTICE.phoneDial);
  });

  var statusEl = document.getElementById('openStatus');
  var statusText = document.getElementById('openStatusText');
  var nextEl = document.getElementById('openNext');
  if (!statusEl || !statusText) return;

  var now = new Date();
  var day = now.getDay();
  var minutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
  var today = PRACTICE.hours[day];

  var fmt = function (mins) {
    var h24 = Math.floor(mins / 60);
    var m = mins % 60;
    var suffix = h24 >= 12 ? 'pm' : 'am';
    var h12 = h24 % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h24 % 12;
    return h12 + ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ' ' + suffix;
  };

  if (today && minutes >= today[0] && minutes < today[1]) {
    statusText.textContent = 'Open now';
    statusEl.classList.add('is-open');
    nextEl.textContent = 'Closing at ' + fmt(today[1]) + ' today.';
  } else {
    statusText.textContent = 'Closed right now';
    statusEl.classList.add('is-closed');
    for (var step = 0; step < 8; step++) {
      var d = (day + step) % 7;
      var slot = PRACTICE.hours[d];
      if (!slot) continue;
      if (step === 0 && minutes >= slot[0]) continue; /* past today's open */
      var label = step === 0 ? 'today' : step === 1 ? 'tomorrow' : DAY_NAMES[d];
      nextEl.textContent =
        'Opens ' + label + ' at ' + fmt(slot[0]) +
        '. Leave a message and the team will call you back.';
      break;
    }
  }

  /* Highlight today's row in the hours list. */
  var row = document.querySelector('#hoursList [data-day="' + day + '"]');
  if (row) row.classList.add('is-today');
});
</script>

<style>*{box-sizing:border-box}*::before{box-sizing:border-box}*::after{box-sizing:border-box}.wz-js{display:none}</style><script class="wz-js" data-embed="">
/* CHAPTER 02 — THE PATH (pinned, scrubbed): the rail draws through the
   three steps. */
WZ.add(function (W) {
  var pin = document.getElementById('pathPin');
  var railFill = document.getElementById('pathRail');
  var cards = gsap.utils.toArray('[data-step-card]');
  if (!pin || !railFill || !cards.length) return;

  /* The rail runs along whichever axis the steps do at this width. */
  var vertical = function () { return window.matchMedia('(max-width: 859px)').matches; };

  var paint = function (p) {
    gsap.set(railFill, vertical() ? { scaleY: p, scaleX: 1 } : { scaleX: p, scaleY: 1 });
    cards.forEach(function (card, i) {
      card.classList.toggle('is-active', p >= i / cards.length + 0.04);
    });
  };

  var mm = gsap.matchMedia();
  mm.add('(min-width: 760px)', function () {
    return W.scrub(
      { trigger: pin, start: 'top top', end: '+=130%', pin: true, scrub: 0.3, anticipatePin: 1, invalidateOnRefresh: true },
      paint
    );
  });
  mm.add('(max-width: 759px)', function () {
    return W.scrub({ trigger: pin, start: 'top 78%', end: 'bottom 60%', scrub: 0.35 }, paint);
  });

  gsap.from(cards, {
    y: 28,
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.8,
    stagger: 0.12,
    ease: 'power3.out',
    scrollTrigger: { trigger: pin, start: 'top 82%' },
  });
});
/* An unlit step list would read as a page that failed to load. */
WZ.staticPaint(function () {
  var rail = document.getElementById('pathRail');
  if (rail) rail.style.transform = 'none';
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-step-card]').forEach(function (c) { c.classList.add('is-active'); });
});
</script>
